book.name: Mareko
book.title: Mareko Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Marekoꞌa Mirihiro

content: Vaze Niduꞌa 4,000 Ḡubuziro
Eꞌe madaḡano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa nuꞌoraro. Ze anoga ogomuḡa oꞌoꞌa radu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ane uhiḡa huze aradu ziro,
“E ꞌahi duḡuru vetuḡaziꞌohe, mazaḡa ze ꞌahao mada uḡidu eḡe teite radiuꞌohe zu ogomuze oꞌoꞌa.
Eḡeꞌa ze vinini nezeo tuḡuzine, ze ibio higau bauriꞌuma, mazaḡa zeḡe boꞌaḡano nuꞌe haba faḡanonoꞌo areha.”
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa naenaeniro, “Haba bohaꞌano ꞌada iniuꞌa ogomu ḡehaḡa madu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ꞌahi ḡubuziꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “Zae mazao ꞌuvahu odogaꞌe nugu?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “ꞌUvahu odogaꞌe fuꞌo aheu fare zu ḡozone komeꞌaꞌe tahiḡa.”

Ebu aniꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa rahao ehoroga radu ziro. Ebu hena ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo aheu fare zu ḡozone nu madu Badiꞌa mazao kuraro. Ebu vahegadu vaze ḡahuge zenoga veize ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziniro, ebu zeꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ḡahugiro.
Zeḡe mazao ḡozone komeꞌa nu zuni eꞌe. Iesuꞌa eꞌe madu kuraro ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa zeadu zeꞌa ḡahugiro.
Vaze niduꞌa au idararo. Ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ogomu ḡahaꞌaḡahaꞌa mae ufadu tunahu niduꞌa fuꞌo aheu fare iri'avoniro.
Eꞌea ogaroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano ohoze daꞌo niduꞌa 4,000. Iesuꞌa ze tuḡuze vaḡiziro.
Ebu ani zogone ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite ḡasio tiradu Dalumanuta habaꞌa onamiro.
Farisea Azaḡaniꞌa Haḡai Nu Badeḡa Umidiro
Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu ani teite ḡadahe taꞌirotitiro. Ze ani tuhune nurihi radu uminiro, “Badiꞌa gigiꞌaḡa hina haḡai nu badeḡa haḡaoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa hereꞌenaꞌa zamaḡaniꞌa adudanadu ꞌahige rae ziro, “Nogadu izidi egaꞌe haḡai nu badeḡa umideꞌohe? Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, haḡai nu badeḡani ꞌahoga zuni mene furenoziniꞌuma.”
Ebu hena aniꞌa ze muhizadu ḡasio bare tiriro ebu duꞌura moneafa fare onamiro.
Farisea Azaḡa zu Herodaꞌe Isiti Heuḡa
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga mae odohoga aḡutaro ebu zeḡe ḡasi zamaḡanoꞌe ꞌuvahu odoga tiba daꞌo horoniro.
ꞌOugadu Iesuꞌa riḡa iraduguziro, “Tohutohoꞌi. Farisea azaḡa zu Heroda ḡiazoꞌi, mazaḡa zeꞌe isiti heuḡa.”
ꞌOugadu ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡoꞌaniro, “Emeḡe mazaoꞌe ꞌuvahu odoga oꞌoꞌa radu ani ꞌouge raꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa ze nagini ḡoꞌanirotaꞌaꞌe ederadu ḡadiziro, “Nougadu zae mazao ꞌuvahu odoga oꞌoꞌa radu ḡoꞌaneꞌohe? Za ꞌize mene horoneꞌehe ga mene edeḡahe? Za zamaze tuḡahe?
Zaꞌe ubumazeta, rehano ehamanoga mene idaḡahe? Ebu teḡazeta, rehano abitoga mene idaḡahe? Za mene zamareꞌehe?
Eḡeꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo hina vaze 5,000 ḡubuzirotene, ḡahaꞌaḡahaꞌaꞌe tunahu nugu iriꞌavoniro?” Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Tunahu gaubanana aheu fare.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “Eḡeꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo aheu fare hina vaze 4,000 ḡubuzirotene, ḡahaꞌaḡahaꞌaꞌe tunahu nugu iriꞌavoniro?” Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Tunahu fuꞌo aheu fare.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Za ꞌize mene edeḡahe?”
Betesaida Neḡano Ubuma Kuruḡa Vazeḡa Fainiro
Zeꞌe Betesaida neḡa ariro. Ebu vaze nuꞌa ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ꞌahoga tutune aradu Iesuꞌa ani obonifine uminiro.
Iesuꞌa ubuma kuruḡa vazeḡa ꞌevoꞌano abinadu ani tutune neonoꞌo vaḡiniro. Aniꞌa vaze eꞌe ubuma rana soꞌabidiro ebu ane ꞌevore ani rana teadu ḡadiniro, “Ḡa ḡau ꞌahoga horoneꞌehe?”
Ani dude ehamanadu niro, “E vaze horozeꞌohe. Ze horozogaꞌe ireꞌa edau ragaveꞌeteꞌe heuḡa.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa bare ane ꞌevore vaze eꞌe ubuma rana tiro. ꞌOugirotene, ane ubumaꞌa raꞌanadu bare ehamaro ebu ḡau niduꞌa faine horoniro.
Iesuꞌa ani ane ne tuḡuneꞌenaꞌa niro, “Betesaida neḡa ago diuḡoꞌi.”
Peteroꞌa Iesuꞌe Keriso rae Reiro
Iesu zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Kaisarea Filipo habaꞌano neḡaneḡa ragave onamiro. Eꞌe ibiḡano Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡadiziro, “Vazeꞌa eꞌe iniu rae raꞌohe?”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Nuꞌe ḡaꞌe Ioane babatiso, nuꞌe Elia, ebu nuꞌe amahi peroveta vazeḡa ꞌahoga rae raꞌohe.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ḡadiziro, “U zaꞌe eꞌe iniu rae raꞌohe?” Peteroꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡaꞌe Keriso.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ḡoere riḡa ziro, “Eḡe moneo vazeni ꞌahoga zuni ago noꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa Ane Aduga zu Rune moneo Ihoziro

Ebu hena Iesuꞌa ane rune moneo ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡadahe ihoziro, “Vaze Ubuganiꞌa aduga ḡehaḡa hidiꞌuma. Ebu vaze boroboro, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa hezahohaꞌuma zu goruniꞌuma. Ebu ani mada uḡidu enogano bare ḡabodiꞌuma.”
Aniꞌa eꞌe moneo deheru ḡoerirotene, Peteroꞌa Iesu ane genaḡano zamahu onamadu ḡadahe roniro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa tehadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡiazeꞌenaꞌa, Petero roniro, “Satani, eḡe mazaonoꞌo vaḡinoꞌi! Ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa gau mene zamareꞌohe, rehano vaze gau zamareꞌohe.”
Ebu hena Iesuꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ane vaḡe huze nuꞌozadu ziro, “Iniuꞌa eḡe hegotihi rae roꞌidene, ane ura niduꞌa modadu ane satauro odoheꞌenaꞌa, eḡe hegotoꞌi.
Mazaḡa iniu ane ḡabone obone giganeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡabone tuḡutuḡu mene hidiꞌuma. Rehano iniuꞌa eḡe zu hari manoḡa veize ane ḡabone ahetine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa haba niduꞌa meiteꞌe ḡarugano ḡaboneḡa daunine, nagi manoḡa hidiꞌuma?
Ḡau ꞌahoga hanadu ḡaboneḡa bare mouga idaḡahe?

Izidi madaḡa azaḡaꞌe daro zu haḡai sauꞌa futauꞌohe. Eꞌe zamaḡano iniuꞌa eḡe zu eḡe ḡoere uꞌano mazagaronine, Vaze Ubuga zuni Moga agaḡano ebu tuḡure viga zaḡoḡa niduꞌa agaḡano ariteꞌe madaḡano vaze eꞌe uꞌano mazagaroniꞌuma.”
